register.labelZh: PUMP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: pump out 可以用來描述抽乾地庫、隧道、船隻、車房和其他地方的積水。；pump somebody up 可以表示鼓舞球隊或表演者;pump yourself up 則可以表示讓自己作好心理準備。；pump something up 常用來表示替單車輪胎、足球、充氣床和類似物品充氣。；人被 pumped up,表示感到興奮並準備就緒;物件被 pumped up,則表示已經充氣。
register.summaryEn: Pump out is useful when describing flooded basements, tunnels, boats, garages and other places filled with water. Pump somebody up can describe encouraging a team or performer. Pump yourself up can describe preparing yourself mentally. Pump something up is commonly used when adding air to bicycle tyres, footballs, air beds and similar objects. A person who is pumped up feels excited and ready. An object that is pumped up has been filled with air.
